Team —

Quick synthesis after yesterday's call with Lauren (Nimbus Health) and procurement: they want a short, actionable MAP that ties the evaluation milestones to an exec briefing (EB) window in late June. Primary asks from Nimbus:
- Finalize executive sponsor roster and which topics each sponsor will own during the EB.
- Lock a 60–90 minute EB date (they prefer a weekday morning PT).
- Share a versioned MAP (milestones, owners, acceptance criteria) and an agenda for the EB.

Proposed next steps (short):
1) We (SDR/AE/CS) align sponsor slate and confirm availability by EOD Mon 5/24.
2) Send MAP v3 (attached) to Nimbus with clear acceptance criteria and a proposed EB agenda.
3) Confirm EB date and send calendar invite with required attendees and briefing notes.

Who owns what: please edit inline in MAP_Nimbus-Health_v3.xlsx and return a PDF by Tue 5/25. I can own the EB agenda and flow; Marissa, you own sponsor assignments + talking points; Ben, please own technical acceptance criteria and any pre-reads; Priya, own procurement redlines tracker.

Notes: I tentatively propose June 23 or 24, 9:00–10:30 PT, as EB windows — will surface alternatives if they don't fit.

Thanks — quick turnaround here is critical to preserve the June close runway.

—Sean
